The Modem Lab uses the vendored SpanDSP implementation from v90modem.
SpanDSP is licensed under GNU LGPL 2.1; see COPYING.spandsp.
Source and build scripts: https://github.com/cryan209/v90modem
  spandsp-master/src/       SpanDSP DSP implementation and local modifications
  web/modem-lab/wasm/       Browser adapter and portable build configuration
  tools/build_modem_wasm.py Rebuild the module with Emscripten 4.0.16

The generated module is unoptimised scalar wasm32. No system SpanDSP is used.
This is an offline software loopback, not a physical-modem interoperability claim.
